description: Implementation of a basic HTTP server that serves static files from assets, handling one request at a time with support for GET method.

classes.name: SimpleWebServer
classes.description: A simple HTTP server class that handles serving static files from assets, supporting only GET requests.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the web server in a new thread, setting it to running state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the web server and closes the server socket.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main server loop accepting connections and handling requests.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an individual client socket request, reads HTTP headers, determines route, and sends response.

methods.name: writeServerError
methods.description: Sends a 500 Internal Server Error response.

methods.name: loadContent
methods.description: Loads file content from assets as byte array.

methods.name: detectMimeType
methods.description: Determines MIME type based on file extension.
